description.value: Roma Italian Ristorante is a casual Italian restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, turning out handmade pizza from a wood-fired oven alongside fresh pasta prepared from scratch by a seasoned chef. The space blends rustic and modern design and is set up for everything from walk-in lunches to private group events and off-site catering. A touring cyclist will find a sit-down meal with full table service, online ordering for pickup, and delivery partnerships for off-bike days.

address.value: 1352 Lonsdale Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2H8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at romarestaurant.ca is live and rich with content, confirming this is an active Italian restaurant at 1352 Lonsdale Ave, North Vancouver. The phone number +1 (604) 990-9986 matches the OSM tag exactly, and the address is provided by the website (absent from OSM). Takeout and delivery are explicitly confirmed ('fast delivery pickup in store', 'Order Online for delivery or pick up'); no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi is found anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Roma Italian Ristorante' but the website consistently uses 'Roma Italian Restaurant' — minor branding discrepancy.

The /contact-us/ subpage contains obvious website-template placeholder content (fictitious Italian-themed locations with Arizona addresses and lorem ipsum text), indicating the contact page was never properly customized. Real contact info is confirmed on the homepage and footer.
OSM address field is empty; address sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active sit-down restaurant with a confirmed address, live website, and full menu. Useful rest and meal stop for touring cyclists on Lonsdale Ave in North Vancouver.
